claims: The Chicago Bulls acquired Jaden Ivey from the Detroit Pistons in a three-team trade before the 2026 deadline.
Kevin Huerter and Dario Šarić moved to the Detroit Pistons in the three-team trade.
In February 2026, the Chicago Bulls acquired Jaden Ivey and Mike Conley Jr. in a three-team trade.
The Detroit Pistons received Kevin Huerter and Dario Šarić in the three-team trade.
The Chicago Bulls waived Jaden Ivey on March 30, 2026.
The Chicago Bulls waived Jaden Ivey due to conduct detrimental to the team following anti-gay comments.
The Chicago Bulls waived Jaden Ivey after Jaden Ivey made anti-gay comments.
The Chicago Bulls deemed the anti-gay comments conduct detrimental to the team.
Jaden Ivey is a 2022 No. 5 draft pick.
Jaden Ivey appeared in only four games for the Chicago Bulls due to ongoing left knee issues.
Jaden Ivey's left knee issues previously limited his playing time in the Detroit Pistons.
